confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on several aggregated sources that roughly agree, so they are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are weaker: sources conflict widely, and the 3-star figure is an approximate blend of the Engine all-class average and seasonal July uplift rather than a direct 3-star average. Rates are pre-tax and pre-tip for most sources, so the anchors may understate what a visitor pays. FX caveat: the search only surfaced RBA observations from 18 to 20 March 2026, not the latest observation as of 2026-10-16, so the fx rate below is likely stale and should be refreshed before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Estimates are built from Los Angeles-specific and US-level aggregated price sources, with the July 2026 window taken into account for accommodation.
